question.html:
The length of a space station is measured to be 100 m according to observer A at rest in the space station.

Observer B is moving at 0.60c with respect to the space station.

a Write down the length of the space station according to Galilean relativity. [1]

b.i Define what is meant by proper length. [1]

b.ii Calculate the length of the space station according to observer B, with reference to special relativity. [2]

c Outline how the results in (b)(ii) contradict Newton’s postulates concerning time and space. [2]
